plain: Being made poor; loss of wealth or strength.

webster.text: Depauperation; a reducing to indigence; exhaustion; drain of wealth, richness or fertility.

example.quote: We should in that case be one of the extremes, and should feel all the impoverishment incident to that situation.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
